postings.title: Engineer, Satellite Platform Engineering
postings.description:
Engineer, Satellite Platform Engineering

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Engineer, Satellite Engineering is part of an EU and US based team that provides engineering, and operations support to the full satellite lifecycle from new satellite procurement through launch, on-orbit operations, and re-orbit. The team is responsible for ensuring the highest levels of satellite service availability through specialized engineering expertise in avionics, attitude control, propulsion, power, and thermal systems across all phases of a satellite’s operational lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include performing routine analysis, adhering to manufacturer-recommended operations, and investigating and resolving system deviations and anomalies. You will develop satellite operations procedures, products, and processes based on manufacturer documentation and operational protocols. In the event of system anomalies, you will develop and implement recovery procedures, ensuring timely and effective resolution to maintain continuous satellite operations. You will also collaborate with engineering teams to provide technical guidance and ensure safe, efficient, and optimal satellite performance.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Continuous surveillance and analysis of telemetry data to evaluate satellite health and performance, trending it against models and predictions, and forecasting likely changes, particularly regarding traffic capacity.

- Providing engineering support for satellite requirement definitions, proposal evaluations, negotiations, and design analysis, ensuring operational experience is considered in new satellite procurements.

- Supporting definition of satellite requirements for integration with satellite operations ground control systems, including the creation of test plans, conducting acceptance tests, and resolving issues.

- Preparing for the launch of new satellites, through support to satellite manufacturer mission design reviews and post launch separation and orbit raising phases.

- Developing, validating and maintaining operational procedures, tools, and processes to maintain optimal satellite and service performance, with a focus to task automation.

- Providing technical advice to internal teams and satellite users regarding satellite capabilities, performance and operations.

- Optimizing satellite performance by performing necessary engineering analysis, modelling, and parameter modifications to meet new business needs.

- Support preparation of on-orbit satellite performance reports to internal and external Customer(s).

- Performing on-call responsibilities on a rotating basis, available to support satellite operations outside of regular business hours, including weekends, to address as requested operations and/or emergency situations. On-call response may require travel to local satellite control center for support actions.

COMPETENCIES

- Technical Proficiency - Strong skills in analysing satellite systems, diagnosing issues, and interpreting data, including evaluating performance metrics and troubleshooting.

- Accountability & Decision-Making – Ability to take ownership, use sound judgment, and make informed decisions under pressure to assess critical situations and propose effective solutions.

- Effective Communication – Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey technical messages clearly and appropriately to both internal and external stakeholders.

- Project Execution – Strong organizational and project management skills to drive initiatives from planning to completion with efficiency and effectiveness.

- Collaboration & Teamwork – Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse and multicultural team environment.

- Results-Driven Approach – Sense of urgency, initiative, and drive to achieve goals and deliver results.

- Continuous Improvement – Proactive approach to identifying opportunities for optimization and driving ongoing improvements.

- Growth Mindset- Embraces challenges as opportunities for learning and personal/professional development.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- 1 to 3 years applicable professional experience in satellite engineering and/or operations are desired, but not mandatory. New Graduate applications are welcome.

- Knowledge of satellite bus subsystems across one or more of Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, MAXAR, Northrop Grumman, Thales is desired, but not mandatory.

- Master’s Degree or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Physics or similar discipline with a specialization in one or more of satellite dynamics and control; avionics, power or thermal sub-systems or similar is required.

- Proficiency with MATLAB and/or Python programming language. Additional courses or knowledge in Computer or Data Science are beneficial.

- Fluency in English (any other language being an asset).

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

- Eligible applicants to the position must meet EU and US export-control authorization requirements for access to Space Segment EAR and ITAR information.

- Willing to work on-site or hybrid remote per allowed policy

- Willing to travel domestically and internationally

postings.title: Engineer, Satellite SDN Control Plane, IRIS2
postings.description:
Engineer, Satellite SDN Control Plane, IRIS2

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

Programme Description

IRIS² is the new European Union secure satellite communications constellation. This project is the European Union's answer to the pressing challenges of tomorrow to provide secure connectivity services and enhanced communication capacities to the EU and its member states, governmental users, private companies, and European citizens while ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones. SES, together with other consortium partners and core members, was selected by the European Commission to build and operate the IRIS² multi-orbit satellite constellation.

The IRIS² team is entering the next project phase, creating a strong need for support across the activities related to service provisioning and the products the system can offer in the future.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Satellite SDN Control Plane Engineer to define, dimension, specify, and prototype the control and management plane capabilities required for a dynamic multi-orbit satellite network. This role focuses on SDN control-plane engineering, network management architecture, topology awareness, telemetry, orchestration, automation, and the interfaces needed to operate routing and service capabilities across space and ground segments. The position is ideal for an Engineer who combines deep networking knowledge with hands-on experience in distributed control systems, network automation, and operationally resilient architectures.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Define SDN control-plane and management-plane requirements for IRIS² and related MEO programme network capabilities.

- Design SDN-based control architectures for dynamic topology awareness, path computation, policy enforcement, and service lifecycle management.

- Develop specifications for network management, telemetry, configuration, fault handling, intent/policy workflows, and operational interfaces.

- Dimension control-plane functions for scale, latency, availability, synchronization, and resilience across space and ground infrastructure.

- Prototype control-plane workflows for routing updates, service provisioning, failure handling, network reconfiguration, and closed-loop optimization.

- Specify and evaluate management APIs, data models, SDN controller interfaces, orchestration interfaces, and integration points with data-plane and platform systems.

- Work with simulation, software, validation, and architecture teams to verify control-plane behavior under nominal and degraded scenarios.

- Support the transition of experimental control-plane concepts into production-ready management and orchestration platforms.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES

- Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- 5+ years of relevant industry experience

- Strong experience with software-defined networking, network management systems, routing control planes, or distributed orchestration systems.

- Solid understanding of routing protocols, path computation, traffic engineering, topology discovery, and network resilience mechanisms.

- Familiarity with network automation and management technologies such as YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, streaming telemetry, or similar approaches.

- Experience with Linux networking, containerized services, Kubernetes, virtualized network functions, and cloud-native operational models.

- Programming skills in Python, Go, C/C++, Rust, or similar languages used for network automation and systems engineering.

- Ability to write clear technical specifications, interface definitions, design documents, and validation criteria.

- Experience with performance analysis, fault injection, lab testing, or simulation of distributed network control systems is highly valuable.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

- The candidate must be eligible for a “SECRET” security clearance, in accordance with the national regulations as well as EU/ESA/NATO equivalents

- Willing to work 60% onsite from office

- Travel as required for project realization purposes

Ground Operations Engineer, Network, User Terminals & Assurance, IRIS2

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Ground Operations Engineer – IRIS2 is part of a team responsible for designing and documenting the ground segment architecture and operational processes essential to IRIS2’s multi-orbit (LEO/MEO) satellite service. With a holistic, end-to-end perspective, this role covers gateways, networking, and assurance operations. Rather than focusing on a single subsystem, you will coordinate across multiple domains—gateway infrastructure, terrestrial networks, and service assurance frameworks—to ensure robust, integrated ground operations for IRIS2.
Strong synchronisation with SES-internal departments, collaboration with consortium partners, and frequent exchanges with the institutional customer are of essence in the role. Agility in the production of internal and deliverable documentation is fundamental to achieve.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

5G Core Operations Engineering

- Contribute with the own domain of expertise to the development of operational plans for 5G Core Network, and supporting networking infrastructure, in close coordination with the Mission, Network, Gateway, and Service Operations, while ensuring alignment with IRIS2’s overarching requirements.

- Document architectural components, operations design decisions, CONOPS elements, and technical standards that form the basis of ground operations.

- Inspect and understand IRIS2 terrestrial network architectures and their interworking with the 5G architecture, interconnection points, terminal authentication and commissioning, resource management, and routing policies that link users’ terminals and core services.

- Collaborate with SES-internal stakeholders and Consortium partners to specify operability, quality, redundancy, and scalability requirements for end-to-end connectivity in LEO/MEO environments. Pursue efficiency through high degrees of automation.

Assurance Operations Integration

- Support the outlining of monitoring, fault detection, and incident management processes covering ground systems and service elements.

- Define, in cooperation with Service Operations and in alignment with the Service and Operations team, strategies for the deployment, the exploitation, and the management of the Test User Terminals, for Service Assurance, KPI measurement, and troubleshooting purposes.

- Collaborate to the identification of key performance indicators (KPIs) for ground infrastructure and their integration into the IRIS2 assurance model.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with system engineering, service operations and ILS, and product teams to gather input, align design decisions, and consolidate documentation.

- Coordinate, through the right interfaces, with satellite engineering leads to validate ground infrastructure requirements against orbital and payload constraints.

Technical Standards & Compliance

- Support the production of specifications to ensure that gateways, networks, and associated ground systems adhere to relevant next-generation industry standards, security requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

- Propose best practices and guidelines that uphold reliable operations through high levels of automation, while supporting evolving IRIS2 service needs.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

- Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends in satellite gateways, terrestrial networking, and monitoring systems, recommending advancements to IRIS2’s ground segment approach.

- Conduct feasibility studies or proof-of-concept initiatives that inform the next steps in ground operations optimization.

Documentation

- - Contribute to the production of comprehensive internal and deliverable documentation, along the guidelines provided by the customer, as interpreted and assigned by the workstream lead.

COMPETENCIES

- Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand end-to-end ground segment operations across gateways, networks, 5G Core, user terminals, and assurance systems.

- Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex technical architectures, identify operational risks, and propose pragmatic solutions.

- Strong technical documentation skills, including the ability to translate complex engineering inputs into clear operational concepts, specifications, standards, and deliverables.

- Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across internal teams, consortium partners, suppliers, and institutional customers.

- Ability to operate in a complex, multi-stakeholder programme environment with evolving requirements and high documentation demands.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness.

- Proactive mindset with the ability to drive continuous improvement, automation, and operational efficiency.

- Good communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.

- Ability to work independently while maintaining strong alignment with workstream leads and cross-functional teams.

- Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced programme environment.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Master’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Network Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.

- Relevant experience in satellite ground segment operations, telecommunications networks, 5G Core, secure networking, gateway operations, service assurance, or network/service operations engineering.

The role will be part of a infrastructure team responsible for mission-critical environments supporting satellite communications services, enterprise applications, and secure government or NATO-related projects.

- Support Windows and Linux server platforms, directory services, authentication, patching, hardening, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

- Managing Windows based datacenter infrastructure, with deep knowledge on Micorosft Active Directory and related services(Domain Controllers , DNS etc)

- Implement and maintain secure infrastructure configurations aligned with enterprise security policies, NATO or governmental project requirements, and applicable compliance frameworks.

- Use Infrastructure as Code practices, preferably Terraform or similar tools, to provision, standardize, version-control, and maintain infrastructure resources across virtualized and secure environments.

- Implement declarative configuration management and automation using Ansible or comparable tools to ensure consistent server, platform, and infrastructure configuration across environments.

- Deploy, operate, upgrade, and support Kubernetes clusters and related platform services, including worker node lifecycle, storage and networking integration, observability, backup, and security controls.

- Participate in incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes using structured IT service management practices.

- Maintain high availability, disaster recovery, capacity planning, infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, and technical standards.

- Collaborate with the Network Engineer on routers, switches, firewalls, VLANs, segmentation, connectivity, and infrastructure dependencies.

- Provide out-of-hours support where required for critical incidents, planned maintenance, or secure mission operations.

COMPETENCIES

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Minimum 3–5 years of experience in infrastructure engineering, virtualization, systems administration, or data center operations.

- Hands-on experience with Nutanix AHV, Prism Central, Prism Element, HCI operations, or comparable virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere.

postings.title: Intern, Product Portfolio Management
postings.description:
Intern, Product Systems & Digital Solutions

About SES

At SES, we believe connectivity should empower people, communities, and businesses everywhere. As a global leader in satellite-enabled communications, we operate the world's only multi-orbit GEO and MEO constellation, delivering high-performance connectivity and media services across aviation, maritime, government, enterprise, and mobility sectors.

Our culture is built on innovation, customer focus, technical excellence, and global collaboration. We solve complex challenges, develop cutting-edge technologies, and deliver mission-critical services with real-world impact. If you're driven by curiosity and passionate about shaping the future of connectivity, SES offers an ideal environment to launch and grow your career.

Position Overview

The Product Systems & Digital Solutions Intern will support a strategic program that is creating a consistent digital representation of SES products, services, and enabling resources. The intern will help convert structured business and technical information into practical, interactive tools that allow teams to explore relationships, test scenarios, validate data, and communicate complex portfolio information more clearly.

This 12-month internship is designed for a hands-on builder who enjoys combining software development, data work, and product thinking. Working closely with Digital Architects, Product teams, Engineering, and other stakeholders, the intern will contribute to both user-facing prototypes and the supporting data and backend activities required to make them reliable and useful.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Tool Development & Rapid Prototyping

Build and improve interactive web-based tools that make complex product, service, and resource information easy to navigate, visualize, and explore.

Translate business concepts, workflow needs, and user feedback into working prototypes and incremental product enhancements.

Use modern coding practices and, where available, AI-assisted development tools to accelerate prototyping while maintaining code quality, security awareness, and traceability.

Create clear demonstrations that help stakeholders understand tool capabilities and provide actionable feedback.

Data, Integration & Backend Support

Help gather, organize, cleanse, normalize, and validate structured information received from Product, Engineering, Operations, and architecture stakeholders.

Develop or support data ingestion and transformation routines for sources such as Excel, CSV, JSON, APIs, and structured repositories.

Assist with backend logic, lightweight services, data models, and interfaces that connect curated source information to user-facing experiences.

Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, duplicates, and broken relationships, and work with subject-matter experts to resolve them.

Maintain clear lineage between source data, transformation rules, application outputs, and approved changes.

Architecture & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with two Digital Architects and collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, Operations, IT, and other business stakeholders.

Participate in working sessions to understand domain concepts, user journeys, data relationships, and technical constraints.

Convert architecture guidance and stakeholder requirements into implementable features, data structures, test cases, and documentation.

Communicate progress, blockers, technical trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Quality, Testing & Documentation

Create repeatable tests for data transformations, application behavior, and key user workflows.

Support usability testing, defect triage, regression checks, and validation of outputs with business and technical stakeholders.

Use version control and maintain readable code, setup instructions, decision logs, and solution documentation.

Contribute to a sustainable handover by documenting how components work, how data is updated, and how future contributors can extend the solution.

Program Support

Help maintain backlogs, action items, dependencies, risks, and milestones for the digital workstream.

Prepare concise demonstrations, status updates, diagrams, and supporting materials for stakeholder reviews.

Contribute ideas that simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve the quality and usability of program data.

Qualifications

Required

Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field.

Hands-on coding experience demonstrated through academic projects, internships, personal projects, hackathons, or an online code portfolio.

Working knowledge of at least one general-purpose programming language, preferably Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

Foundational web development skills, including HTML, CSS, and client-side application development.

Ability to work with structured data and common formats such as Excel, CSV, and JSON.

Basic understanding of APIs, databases, data modeling, or backend application concepts.

Familiarity with Git or another version-control system and willingness to follow collaborative development practices.

Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to troubleshoot problems methodically.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team.

Preferred

Experience building a functioning web application, dashboard, data tool, or interactive prototype from concept to demonstration.

Exposure to a modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, Vue, or an equivalent technology.

Experience with Python-based data processing, SQL, REST APIs, lightweight backend frameworks, or cloud development environments.

Familiarity with automated testing, debugging, CI/CD concepts, containerization, or application deployment.

Experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly to explore solutions, generate scaffolding, troubleshoot, refactor, or document code.

Understanding of product management, systems thinking, enterprise architecture, telecommunications, satellite technology, or digital-twin concepts is a plus.

Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Power BI, Jira, or comparable delivery and visualization tools is beneficial.

Basic Skills Required to Apply

Applicants should be able to demonstrate the following foundational capabilities at the time of application:

Build & Demonstrate

Provide examples of code or working solutions, such as a GitHub repository, personal project, course project, hackathon submission, or live demonstration.

Explain the problem addressed, the approach taken, personal contribution, key technical decisions, and lessons learned.

Intern, Spectrum Management and Strategy

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of the Spectrum team within a dynamic industry and be involved in projects allowing or the spectrum team to have fast and precise access to critical information by contributing to integrate spectrum coordination and administrative data from into new database tools. In the process you will be able to learn about various and fascinating aspects of satellite frequency coordination and related regulatory aspects.

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

PROGRAMME DESCRIPTION

IRIS2 is the new European Union secure satellite constellation. This project is the European Union's answer to the pressing challenges of tomorrow to provide secure connectivity services and enhanced communication capacities to the EU and its Member States. In addition, as well as to governmental users, private companies and European citizens while benefiting from ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones.

SES – together with other consortium partners and core members, was selected by the European Commission to build and to operate the IRIS2 multi-orbit satellite constellation.

The IRIS2 team enters next project phases, we seek and there is a strong need of support for all the activities around service provisioning and products that the system can offer in the future

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Enterprise Architecture & Digital Transformation Manager is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining, governing, and implementing the integrated digital ecosystem supporting programme execution across engineering, manufacturing, integration & validation, operations, and programme management activities.

The role ensures that enterprise tools, data flows, and digital capabilities support efficient programme execution and operational excellence throughout the lifecycle of complex aerospace, space, and telecommunications programmes.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Manager, Payroll Americas & LATAM oversees the payroll function for the Americas, covering the United States, Brazil, Mexico, Canada and Colombia. The role ensures the accurate calculation, processing, disbursement, reconciliation and compliance of payroll, payroll taxes, benefits deductions and statutory reporting across the region. The incumbent is also responsible for updating, validating and maintaining the SAP SuccessFactors (SAP SF) and ADP Vantage payroll data for the Americas, including employee lifecycle transactions and interfaces with internal teams and external providers.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Ensure the correct calculation and disbursement of all payroll checks, direct deposits and payroll taxes for employees in the Americas across the current payrolls in scope.

- Manage year-end payroll processing, including Retiree Life insurance inputs, expatriate compensation files to tax providers, employee inputs received from external vendors, applicable reconciliations, and finalization of employee W-2s.

- Manage benefits contribution and defined contribution updates through third-party vendors, including annual updates and ad hoc adjustments to reflect correct employee contributions.

- Maintain pay codes to ensure correct taxability and inclusion or exclusion from 401(k) compensation, and monitor compliance with 401(k) IRS limits.

- Update and validate additions and changes in ADP Vantage payroll, SAP SF and related interfaces, ensuring strong data integrity across systems.

- Process all special payments, including commission payments, bonus payments and recognition payments.

- Monitor federal, state and local compensation and tax laws and regulations to ensure governmental reporting and payroll compliance.

- Calculate expatriate pay advice and support expatriate / shadow payroll arrangements where required.

- Ensure data integrity across ADP Vantage payroll and SAP SF systems, and act as liaison with internal departments and external vendors to resolve payroll, tax and SAP SF-related issues.

- Manage the interface with the SAP SF time reporting module, external vendors and ADP self-service functionality.

- Recommend SAP SF data changes and take the lead for U.S. projects associated with such updates, including testing and reporting of SAP SF system updates.

- Work with the HRIS team members and relevant system owners to resolve SAP SF issues and maintain the quality of personnel data in SAP SF.

- Input and validate new hire, job change, promotion, termination and leave status data within SAP SF.

- Ensure recordkeeping compliance for required employment documentation.

- Provide data to third-party vendors in connection with annual EEO, VETS and AAP reporting, and manage related vendor relationships.

- Complete U.S. Department of Labor surveys in connection with location, headcount and salary data.

- Prepare and submit annual IRS ACA information reporting.

- Perform accurate bi-weekly and monthly payroll processing, reconciliation, payroll accounting and SOX controls.

- Support payroll, HRIS, Rewards & Benefits (R&B) and Finance projects, and perform other duties as assigned.

COMPETENCIES

- Proficiency in Excel and Word required; PowerPoint experience preferred.

- Strong collaboration skills and constructive team-player mindset, with the ability to work across HR, R&B, Finance, Tax, external vendors and employees.

- Proven track record in process improvement and customer service, with demonstrated initiative to take the lead in implementing changes and improving processes.

- Effective oral and written communication skills, including the ability to interact professionally with employees and stakeholders at all levels.

- High level of confidentiality and discretion in daily operations and when handling sensitive payroll, tax and employee data.

- Strong data integrity, complex problem-resolution and analytical skills, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to use logic and reasoning to demonstrate problem sensitivity, set priorities, meet deadlines and work independently.

- Proactive, reliable and accountable approach, with the ability to escalate issues appropriately and close payroll activities on time.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

- Ten or more years of payroll experience, including significant U.S. payroll experience; multi-country Americas payroll experience is strongly preferred.

- Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal, state and local payroll tax requirements, wage and hour concepts, 401(k), W-2, ACA, EEO/VETS/AAP reporting and employment-recordkeeping requirements.

- Experience with ADP Vantage payroll systems, SAP SF and HRIS/payroll interfaces; experience testing system changes and resolving data issues is preferred.

- Experience coordinating with external payroll providers, tax providers, benefit vendors and third-party reporting vendors.

- Payroll accounting expertise is mandatory

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.

- CPP certification or equivalent payroll certification is preferred.

- Fluent English, both spoken and written

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

- Key interfaces include external payroll providers, HR Business Partners, HR Operations, Compensation & Benefits, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, employees and managers.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator with a growth mindset, strong facilitation skills, and practical experience applying Korn Ferry methodology to develop talent and capabilities across the organization.

postings.title: Manager, Talent Management & Engagement
postings.description:
Manager, Talent & Engagement

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Talent & Engagement Manager supports SES’s global talent management, performance, leadership development, and engagement programs end-to-end, from business case and design through deployment, adoption, and measurement. The role is SES’s subject matter expert on talent frameworks, translating workforce insight into decisions that advance business objectives and cultural priorities. Working within broad guidelines and with a high degree of autonomy, it sets program direction and influences senior stakeholders across regions and functions. This is a senior individual contributor role that delivers impact through program ownership and deep expertise.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

Primary functions are listed in order of importance, with the approximate percentage of time spent on each over the course of a year. The role carries no supervisory responsibility. Decisions shape how talent, performance, and engagement processes operate across the enterprise; changes to policy, investment, and program design are recommended to the Senior Manager, Talent Management & Engagement for approval.

- Performance Management (25% of time)

- Support the global performance management cycle end-to-end, running the operational backbone of each cycle: system readiness and configuration, population and data accuracy, cycle communications, and the calendar that keeps employees and managers aligned on priorities and timelines.

- Create and deliver the enabling resources for each cycle: manager and employee guides, toolkits, training sessions, FAQs, and office hours.

- Track cycle progress and completion across regions, troubleshoot issues as they surface, and escalate risks.

- Analyse cycle outcomes. completion rates, rating distribution, and business feedback; recommend evidence-based improvements year over year.

- Leadership Development (25% of time)

- Own the leadership development portfolio end-to-end for people managers and emerging leaders globally, aligning programming to SES’s four leadership development pillars and covering vendor and facilitator selection, delivery, and evaluation.

- Maintain the leadership capability framework and the learning pathways beneath it, keeping both aligned to business strategy and in support of leadership needs.

- Direct end-to-end delivery of virtual and live programs, whether hosted internally or through external vendors, including logistics, facilitation support, participant experience, and the supporting assets (campaigns, decks, toolkits, and surveys).

- Measure impact beyond attendance: behaviour change, capability growth, and business outcomes.

- Advise HRBPs and business leaders as the internal expert and escalation point on leadership development, and manage the associated budget line and external partner relationships.

- Employee Engagement & Culture (20% of time)

- Partner on the global engagement survey end-to-end: planning, communications, insight generation, and action planning that drives visible follow-through.

- Support the initiatives that strengthen company culture and the employee experience, including team development, belonging, recognition, and well-being.

- Maintain and update the Talent Management & Engagement intranet pages and resource library in partnership with Corporate Communications.

- Data Insights & Reporting (15% of time)

- Define the metrics that matter, then generate, analyse, and interpret data on employee engagement, performance, development, and retention.

- Support reporting on global HR KPIs, dashboards, and analytics for the Talent Management & Engagement portfolio.

- Translate analysis into clear recommendations and trade-offs and present them directly to HR leadership and business unit executives.

- Vendor Management (15% of time)

- Select and manage the external vendors supporting leadership development, learning programs, and engagement platforms.

postings.title: Network Engineer - Secure Network, Perimeter, and Connectivity Services
postings.description:
Network Engineer - Secure Network, Perimeter, and Connectivity Services

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Network Engineer will be responsible for the design, implementation, administration, security, and operational support of SES Satellites’ enterprise and mission-support network infrastructure. This includes routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, routing, switching, segmentation, remote connectivity, monitoring, network documentation, and coordination with infrastructure platforms hosted on Nutanix.

The role supports secure communications and infrastructure availability for satellite operations, corporate IT, and governmental or NATO-related projects. The Network Engineer will act as the team’s primary network and perimeter-security specialist while collaborating closely with the two Infrastructure Engineers to ensure end-to-end resilience across compute, storage, virtualization, and network layers.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Design, configure, operate, and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, data center, and secure connectivity services across routers, switches, firewalls, and VPN platforms.

- Manage network segmentation, VLANs, routing protocols, access control policies, firewall rules, NAT, secure remote access, and network resilience.

- Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and security events, performing root-cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.

- Support secure integration between Nutanix-hosted workloads, corporate systems, satellite operations environments, and external customer or governmental networks.

- Support Infrastructure as Code practices, preferably Terraform or similar tools, for repeatable deployment and version-controlled management of network-related infrastructure components where applicable.

- Use declarative configuration management approaches, including Ansible or comparable tools, to automate network configuration, enforce standards, and reduce manual configuration drift.

- Deploy, integrate, and support Kubernetes cluster networking requirements, including ingress, service networking, network policies, load balancing, DNS, connectivity, and firewall dependencies.

- Apply security hardening, patching, configuration backup, vulnerability remediation, change control, and compliance documentation for network devices.

- Develop and maintain network diagrams, configuration standards, operational procedures, firewall rule documentation, and recovery runbooks.

- Coordinate with vendors, security teams, infrastructure engineers, and project stakeholders during incidents, upgrades, audits, and new service deployments.

- Support on-call or planned maintenance activities for high-priority services and mission-critical connectivity.

COMPETENCIES

- Demonstrated capability to collaborate effectively, work as part of a team, share knowledge, and contribute constructively within a small multidisciplinary infrastructure function.

- Excellent analytical, documentation, stakeholder-management, and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical network matters to both technical and non-technical audiences.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.

- Minimum 4–6 years of experience in network engineering, network operations, firewall administration, or secure enterprise connectivity.

- Strong hands-on experience with enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, routing and switching technologies, VPNs, monitoring tools, and network troubleshooting.

- Good understanding of virtualization and HCI network dependencies, including VLANs, virtual switching, storage/network traffic separation, and data center connectivity.

- Experience in security-sensitive, regulated, governmental, telecoms, defense, or satellite communications environments is strongly preferred.

- Relevant certifications are preferred, such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto, Check Point, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, or equivalent vendor certifications.

- Fluency in English, written and spoken, is mandatory for operational communication, documentation, vendor coordination, and work on international or governmental projects.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

- Eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain NATO, EU, national governmental, or other project-specific security clearance as required.

- Willing to work at least 60% onsite from office

postings.title: Principal Media Architect
postings.description:
Senior Architect, Media Architecture

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Principal Media Architect / Analyst is an experienced technical contributor responsible for developing, applying, and maintaining technical architectures that support the organization’s media services and platforms. The role develops scalable and supportable service designs within established architectural standards and translates product, customer, and commercial requirements into practical technical solutions.

This position provides technical expertise within the Media Architecture team and contributes to the adoption of reusable reference architectures, consistent design patterns, and engineering best practices. Working with senior architecture and engineering leadership, the role supports design decisions, identifies technical concerns, and helps ensure proposed solutions are compatible with current and planned media-platform capabilities.

We are seeking a candidate who works collaboratively with technical stakeholders to identify requirements, architecture gaps, implementation dependencies, and operational considerations during the service-development process. The role supports the transition from customer and product requirements through architecture, detailed engineering, implementation, and operational readiness, while escalating significant architecture exceptions, risks, or decisions when required. The position contributes to improved standardization, documentation, monitoring, supportability, service stability, and reduction of technical debt across media services.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Apply and maintain approved reference architectures and standardized design patterns for media platforms and services, and contribute recommendations for their continued improvement.

- Translate product capabilities, customer requirements, service definitions, and commercial commitments into technical designs that are scalable, supportable, and aligned with established platform standards.

- Develop high-level designs, logical signal flows, system boundaries, interfaces, dependencies, resiliency approaches, monitoring requirements, capacity considerations, and operational requirements for assigned solutions.

- Collaborate with Product, Commercial, Planning, and Engineering teams to assess whether proposed services align with current and planned platform capabilities and identify gaps requiring further review.

- Coordinate technical inputs across Product, Planning, Network Engineering, Media Engineering, Execution, and Operations; identify dependencies, constraints, and risks; and escalate significant design conflicts or unresolved decisions.

- Support Planning and Media Architects with solution shaping, technical feasibility assessments, application of architecture standards, and identification of operational or implementation constraints before commitments are finalized.

- Participate in architecture and design reviews, assess proposed solutions against approved standards, document architecture decisions and exceptions, and provide technical recommendations to senior architecture leadership.

- Develop implementation-ready architectural designs, identify sequencing, migration, rollback, and acceptance considerations, support Engineering Design Readiness reviews, and assist in confirming that implementations remain aligned with approved designs.

- Support operational readiness by ensuring assigned solutions include appropriate implementation traceability, service inventory information, technical documentation, support procedures, recovery considerations, and handover deliverables.

- Contribute technical expertise to transformation initiatives, technology evaluations, platform simplification, technical-debt reduction, and updates to architecture standards based on deployment and operational experience.

COMPETENCIES

- Represent the department as part of the broader Network Engineering leadership team

- Follow defined engineering processes and help maintain high-quality technical designs, implementation deliverables, and documentation.

- Apply end-to-end systems thinking to identify technical gaps, operational risks, and implementation dependencies, and provide recommendations or escalate issues requiring broader architectural review.

- Support operational readiness within media implementation processes and collaborate across teams to improve the completeness and consistency of architecture and as-built documentation.

- Collaborate with Product, Commercial, Planning, Engineering, Execution, and Operations to reduce design exceptions, unsupported implementations, and unnecessary technical variation through the application of established standards.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, telecommunications, computer engineering, computer science, broadcast engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

- At least five years of relevant experience designing, integrating, implementing, or supporting media, broadcast, video, telecommunications, or content-distribution systems.

- Experience contributing to end-to-end technical designs involving multiple platforms, locations, interfaces, and engineering disciplines.

- Solid understanding of architecture principles, systems engineering, technical standards, and service lifecycle considerations.

- Experience creating high-level designs, system diagrams, signal flows, implementation requirements, and contributing to reference architectures and technical standards.

- Experience translating product, business, or customer requirements into technically realizable solutions.

- Working knowledge of service resilience, redundancy, monitoring, fault management, capacity planning, performance, and operational support requirements.

- Ability to evaluate technical information, identify risks and tradeoffs, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

- Strong written communication, technical documentation, collaboration, and presentation skills.

- Ability to perform physical support activities when required (e.g., cable handling, racking/stacking hardware).

- Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 20–25%.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

- Degree in engineering, telecommunications, computer science, systems architecture, or a related discipline is desirable.

- Experience with media contribution, processing, transport, distribution, or playout environments.

- Experience with traditional broadcast and familiarity with IP-based media, cloud, virtualized, or hybrid media architectures.

- Familiarity with media-service monitoring, service inventory, configuration management, CMDB integration, and operational-assurance platforms.

- Experience supporting platform transformations, network migrations, technology-refresh programs, or service-modernization initiatives.

- Familiarity with architecture exception processes, technical-debt remediation approaches, and target-state roadmaps.

- Familiarity with systems-engineering, enterprise-architecture, or architecture-governance frameworks.

- Experience mentoring engineers or providing technical guidance within project or geographically distributed teams.

Senior Systems Engineer

SES Commercial Aviation team has an exciting opportunity for a Principal Systems Engineer. You will help us design and develop solutions aimed at providing key features, functionality, and future vision for Commercial Aviation connectivity to deliver an at home internet access experience while sitting on an airplane. Solutions integrate many individual sub-systems from the users’ connected devices, through the aircraft, across satellites, ground-based teleports, data centers, and to the internet. The ideal candidate for this role will be a working member of the Commercial Aviation systems engineering team delivering quality technical solutions that address strategic technical and business needs carrying through concept, design, deployment, and field support. This role requires solid understanding of networking, ability to learn cutting edge technology and to drive its application to next generation solution realization, being able to communicate technical solutions and concepts in both written and verbal means to a variety of people and organizations, and contribute to cross-functional teams (such as hardware engineering, network engineering, satellite engineering, operations, satellite capacity planning) within SES, with suppliers, and with customers.

postings.description:
Project Manager Security Domain, IRIS2 Programme Office

ProgramME Description

IRIS2 is the new European Union secure satellite constellation. This project is the European Union's answer to the pressing challenges of tomorrow to provide secure connectivity services and enhanced communication capacities to the EU and its Member States. In addition, as well as to governmental users, private companies and European citizens while benefiting from ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones.

SES – together with other consortium partners and core members – has been selected by European Commission to build and to operate the IRIS2 multi-orbit satellite constellation.

As the project enters its next phase, our team is expanding to support the development of future services and products enabled by the IRIS2 system. We are now seeking skilled professionals to help shape the service provisioning landscape and ensure the successful deployment of cutting-edge satellite connectivity solutions.

Role Description

As a member of an agile project organization, you will be expected to bring a flexible way of working and an adaptive mindset to a dynamic development environment.

In your Project Manager role, you horizontally overlook the smooth execution of the Security Domain of the Project keeping track of the timeline, milestones as well as the budget for the scope defined.

You will work closely with technical experts and other stakeholders like Finance or Procurement following strict standards and rules with regards to all relevant activities.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Lead the planning and execution of security work packages within the IRIS² program, in coordination with Security Domain Leader, EC, ESA, and industrial partners.

- Coordinate the development of security documentation, including risk assessments, security architecture, threat models, and compliance roadmaps.

- Ensure alignment with EU regulations related to classified information, export control, and cybersecurity

- Manage the classification and handling of documents (e.g., SES Confidential, EU Sensitive), including liaison with security accreditation authorities.

- Monitor progress, track dependencies, and report on KPIs and risks related to security deliverables.

- Facilitate communication between technical teams, security stakeholders, and program leadership.

- Support the preparation of export control assessments and license applications where required.

- Represent the security team in internal and external reviews, audits, and coordination meetings.

- Contribute to the development of security governance frameworks and operational policies.

- In cooperation with Supply Chain teams and Engineering teams, identify project (sub-) contractors and vendors, execute RFPs, set-up and manage (sub-) contracts

- In cooperation with Finance team, manage budgets/resources aiming at cost control and cost anticipation/forecasting

- Report to Programme Management on the project evolvement

COMPETENCIES

- Excellent project management skills, with strong time management skills to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment

- Strong ability to work independently and with limited supervision in complex environments, e.g. project or matrix organizations

- Flexibility and adaptability in response to changing project requirements and environments

- Ability to think strategically and align project goals with organizational objectives

- Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities

- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal

- Strong leadership and teamwork skills, with experience managing diverse expert teams and complex project organizations

- Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities

- Innovation mindset, encouraging and contributing to innovative approaches and solutions.

- Proactive approach, can-do mentality and ability to work autonomously

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- University Degree in either Telecom, IT or Satellite Engineering or equivalent

- Minimum 5 years experience in the participation (at least partially) in the design, development, implementation, testing, validation and operations of satellite and/or ground systems / equivalent complex aerospace programmes

(Senior) RAMS Engineer, IRIS2

Programme Description

IRIS2 is the new European Union secure satellite constellation. This project is the European Union's answer to the pressing challenges of tomorrow to provide secure connectivity services and enhanced communication capacities to the EU and its Member States as well as to governmental users, private companies and European citizens while ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones.

SES – together with other consortium partners and core members - was selected by European Commission to build and to operate the IRIS2 multi-orbit satellite constellation.

The IRIS2 team enters next project phases and there is a strong need of support for all the activities around service provisioning and products that the system can offer in the future.

Role Description

The RAMS Engineer (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) is responsible for ensuring that all system and subsystem designs within the IRIS² programme meet the required dependability and safety objectives in accordance with ECSS-Q-ST-30C Rev.1 and the IRIS² Product Assurance and Safety Requirements Document.
The RAMS Engineer operates within the Product Assurance (PA) discipline and plays a key role in defining, reviewing, and validating RAMS requirements throughout the system lifecycle — from early design through to verification and delivery.

As a member of an agile project organization, you will be expected to bring a flexible way of working and an adaptive mindset to a dynamic development environment.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- RAMS Requirements Management

- - Identify and define the main RAMS requirements in coordination with SES/SpaceRise, ensuring proper flow-down to industrial partners and subcontractors.

- Ensure consistency of RAMS requirements across System, Space Segment, and Ground Segment levels.

- Support the breakdown of high-level RAMS requirements down to subsystem and equipment level.

- Maintain traceability between top-level PA/RAMS requirements and lower-level implementation.

- Design and Development Phase (Main Workload)

- - Develop and deliver RAMS documentation according to the IRIS² PA Requirements and the Document Requirements List (DRL) applicable to the project.

- Conduct, review, and consolidate the following analyses across system and segment levels:

- Reliability Analysis

- FMEA/FMECA (Failure Modes, Effects and Criticality Analysis)

- HSIA (Hardware/Software Interaction Analysis)

- Contingency Analysis

- Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)

- Common Cause Analysis (CCA)

- Worst Case and Parts Stress Analyses (as applicable)

- Availability Analysis

- Failure Detection, Isolation, and Recovery (FDIR) Analysis

- Hazard Analysis

- Dependability Critical Items Identification (CIL) and Reporting

- Procurement and Subcontractor Management

- - Review RAMS deliverables and technical documentation provided by subcontractors and suppliers during contractual reviews.

- Assess subcontractor compliance to RAMS requirements and ensure adequacy of inputs to system-level RAMS documentation.

- Provide expert feedback and guidance to ensure subcontracted designs meet reliability, availability, and safety criteria.

- Consolidate lower-level documentation (spacecraft and ground) into system-level RAMS reports.

- Reporting and Documentation

- - Prepare and maintain RAMS documentation deliverables, ensuring compliance with PA requirements and project milestones.

- Contribute RAMS reporting elements to progress reports and system reviews (e.g., PDR, CDR).

- Support preparation of Safety Data Packages and ensure proper hazard tracking and closure.

- Interface with Product Assurance, Engineering, and Safety teams to ensure coherent integration of RAMS activities within the system lifecycle.

________________________________________

- Deliverables

- - System-Level RAMS Plan and Reports

- Reliability, Availability, and Safety Analyses (System, Spacecraft, and Ground)

- FMEA/FMECA Reports

- Fault Tree and Common Cause Analyses

- Critical Items List (CIL)

- Hazard Analysis and Safety Data Package

- Dependability Status in Progress Reports

- RAMS Input for PDR, CDR, and Qualification Reviews

COMPETENCIES

- Strong ability to work independently and with limited supervision in complex environments, e.g. project or matrix organizations

- Flexibility and adaptability in response to changing project requirements and environments

- Ability to think strategically and align project goals with organizational objectives

- Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities

- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal

- Strong leadership and teamwork skills, with experience managing diverse expert teams and complex project organizations

- Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities

- Innovation mindset, encouraging and contributing to innovative approaches and solutions.

- Proactive approach, can-do mentality and ability to work autonomously

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Reliability Engineering, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in RAMS or Product Assurance in the space or aerospace sector.

- Strong knowledge of ECSS-Q-ST-30C Rev.1 and related ECSS standards for dependability and safety.

postings.description:
Satellite Manufacturing Engineer Product - Electronics Assembly

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Electronics Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for the manufacturability of electronic assemblies throughout the product lifecycle, from concept through production and sustaining. Working closely with Electrical Design Engineering, the role ensures PCBAs are optimized for manufacturing, test, procurement, quality, reliability, and cost. As the technical authority for Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Test (DFT), and Design for Procurement (DFP), the Electronics Manufacturing Engineer drives design decisions that enable efficient, repeatable, and scalable production while supporting hands-on resolution of complex manufacturing and product issues.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the manufacturability of PCBA designs from concept through production and sustaining.

- Lead DFM, DFT, and DFP reviews with Electrical Engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

- Review and influence schematics, PCB layouts, BOMs, and manufacturing documentation to improve manufacturability, testability, reliability, and supply chain resilience.

- Define manufacturing processes, assembly methods, tooling, and production documentation for electronic assemblies.

- Support prototype builds, NPI, qualification, and production ramp, resolving design and manufacturing issues through practical, hands-on engineering.

- Perform root cause analysis of manufacturing and field failures, driving effective corrective and preventive actions.

- Partner with PCB designers, hardware engineers, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to improve yield, quality, cost, and production readiness.

- Support engineering change management, ensuring manufacturability impacts are assessed and implemented throughout the product lifecycle.

- Drive continuous improvement across electronics manufacturing processes, test coverage, quality, and manufacturing efficiency.

COMPETENCIES, QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Manufacturing, or Mechatronics Engineering.

- 5+ years of experience in electronics manufacturing engineering, PCBA manufacturing, or New Product Introduction (NPI).

- Proven experience applying DFM, DFT, and DFP principles to complex electronic products.

We are seeking a Satellite Network Simulation & Emulation Engineer to build and operate simulation, emulation, and digital twin environments dedicated to the networking aspects of the IRIS² and MEO programme architecture. This role works closely with constellation simulation teams while focusing specifically on routing, traffic engineering, SDN control-plane behavior, data-plane performance, congestion, failures, and service validation using networking tools and statistically rigorous evaluation methods. - Automate experiment execution, result processing, visualization, and reporting for technical stakeholders.

Qualifications Background and Experience

- Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- Strong background in network simulation, emulation, discrete-event simulation, performance modeling, or digital twin development.

- Hands-on experience with tools such as ns-3, OMNeT++, Mininet, container-based testbeds, traffic generators, or custom simulation frameworks.

- Solid understanding of routing, traffic engineering, congestion control, QoS, failure recovery, and distributed network systems.

- Programming skills in Python, C/C++, Rust, or similar languages used for simulation and systems engineering.

- Experience with statistical evaluation, experimental design, benchmarking, visualization, and analysis of large experiment data sets.

postings.description:
Senior Architect, Mission Test & Pathfinder Integration, meoSphere

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

PROGRAMME DESCRIPTION

meoSphere is SES’s next-generation Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) satellite constellation, designed to deliver secure connectivity services to government agencies, enterprises, and commercial customers. It will also provide high-speed broadband internet to eliminate global connectivity dead zones.

To accelerate development timelines, reduce costs, and ensure quality, SES is internalizing a critical segment of the satellite supply chain: the final integration of partner satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads, all within a cutting-edge manufacturing and test facility.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The System Integration & Test (SI&T) Mission Test Lead is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for developing and delivering mission-test capabilities across a complex system-of-systems environment spanning spacecraft, ground systems, user terminals, communications networks, software platforms, operational processes, and supporting infrastructure.

Working within the SI&T function, you will develop campaign plans, test procedures, readiness criteria, technical analyses, and evidence packages to verify mission objectives and demonstrate operational readiness. Leading through technical expertise and influence, you will coordinate engineering, operations, suppliers, and program stakeholders to deliver successful mission-test campaigns.

The role supports ongoing Pathfinder activities while preparing future campaigns, leading rehearsals, readiness reviews, delegated mission-test execution, anomaly and retest coordination, and evidence closeout. While providing mission-test leadership during execution, spacecraft command authority and flight operations decisions remain with the designated flight authorities and operational organizations.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

Shared Responsibilities

- Lead system integration, testing, verification, and validation work across hardware, software, networks, operations, laboratories, suppliers, and distributed teams.

- Turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear, practical technical plans with visible assumptions, dependencies, risks, and evidence needs.

- Apply discipline across requirements, interfaces, configuration control, readiness, anomalies, regression, traceability, and evidence.

- Produce clear, decision-ready technical recommendations and communicate effectively with engineering, program, supplier, and executive stakeholders.

- Define and lead System Integration & Test work while respecting retained authorities in product, facility, safety, flight, requirements, procurement, and acceptance decisions.

Focus Area Responsibilities:

- Lead the development, planning, and execution of mission-test campaigns, translating mission objectives into executable event sequences, procedures, readiness criteria, and evidence requirements.

- Develop campaign strategies, technical solutions, and test approaches supporting concurrent Pathfinder and future mission-test activities.

- Define test success criteria, including entry and exit criteria, pass/fail measures, data collection requirements, abort conditions, and recovery approaches.

- Lead campaign rehearsals, technical reviews, and readiness assessments to ensure stakeholders, systems, procedures, and environments are prepared for execution.

- Coordinate anomaly investigation, retest planning, and technical resolution activities, providing recommendations based on evidence and test outcomes.

- Lead delegated mission-test execution activities in accordance with approved procedures and governance frameworks, while respecting retained flight and spacecraft command authorities.

- Maintain end-to-end test traceability, ensuring evidence, decisions, actions, and outcomes are captured, reviewed, and closed out appropriately.

Key Year 1 Deliverables

By the end of the first year, you will have established the mission-test planning, readiness, and execution capability required to support ongoing Pathfinder testing and future mission-test campaigns across the program. The program will have a consistent approach to campaign planning, rehearsals, delegated mission-test execution, anomaly and retest coordination, and evidence closeout. Key deliverables will include:

- Executable mission-test campaign plans with defined event sequences, readiness criteria, data requirements, evidence expectations, and anomaly response processes.

- Mission-test procedures, rehearsal plans, and readiness review processes supporting ongoing and future Pathfinder activities.

- Teams prepared for delegated mission-test execution, with roles, responsibilities, and decision paths validated through rehearsals and readiness activities.

- Established anomaly investigation, retest coordination, and evidence assessment processes.

- End-to-end traceability from mission objectives through campaign execution, evidence collection, and closeout.

- Mission-test governance and execution practices operating within established flight authority frameworks.

Qualifications Background and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- Minimum 10 years of experience in test engineering, system integration, verification and validation, mission operations, flight testing, or other complex system test environments.

- Proven technical leadership, including planning and executing complex test campaigns and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.

- Strong understanding of requirements management, system interfaces, configuration control, readiness reviews, anomaly resolution, technical risk management, and evidence-based decision-making.

- Excellent technical writing, facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and executive communication skills.

- Experience in space systems, satellite communications, ground systems, mission operations, telecommunications, or other mission-critical engineering programs.

- Familiarity with systems engineering practices, test automation, hardware-in-the-loop environments, simulators, digital twins, and test management tools.

- Experience supporting flight-test, launch, satellite operations, FlatSat, field-test, or similar high-consequence test and operational environments is highly desirable.

postings.description:
Senior Engineer, Resource Optimization & Algorithm, IRIS2

PROGRAMME description

IRIS² is the new European Union secure satellite communications constellation. This project is the European Union's answer to the pressing challenges of tomorrow to provide secure connectivity services and enhanced communication capacities to the EU and its Member States as well as to governmental users, private companies and European citizens while ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones.

SES – together with other consortium partners and core members – was selected by European Commission to build and to operate the IRIS² multi-orbit satellite constellation.

The IRIS² team enters the next project phase and there is a strong need for support for all the activities around service provisioning and products that the system can offer in the future.

Role description summary

Work requirements

The Resource Optimization and Algorithm Engineer is responsible for designing, modelling, simulating and validating optimization algorithms for radio, transport, feeder-link, inter-satellite link and gateway resource allocation in a 5G-NTN multi-orbit satellite system. The role supports MCC/SMO orchestration by developing algorithms for capacity planning, routing, scheduling, congestion avoidance, contingency handling, handover support and SLA-driven service continuity. The engineer combines classical and advanced optimization techniques with 5G-NTN system knowledge to support practical resource orchestration decisions across RAN, satellite payload, feeder links, ISLs and gateways.

General work requirements

- Design, model and validate optimization algorithms for radio, transport, gateway, feeder-link and ISL resource allocation in 5G-NTN systems.

- Develop resource allocation, routing, scheduling, capacity planning, congestion avoidance and contingency-handling algorithms for MCC/SMO orchestration use cases.

- Model RAN resources, beams/cells, feeder links, ISLs, gateways, satellite visibility constraints, QoS, network slicing, traffic prioritization and SLA continuity requirements.

- Simulate algorithm performance under nominal and degraded scenarios, including mobility, handover support, gateway congestion, ISL constraints, feeder-link limitations and traffic demand variations.

- Provide algorithmic input to architecture studies, trade-off analyses, RFP/RFQ technical content, vendor evaluation, integration planning and system performance assessments.

Qualifications Background and Experience

Qualification Basis

- Master's degree in engineering or science, preferably in Telecommunications Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

- Experience in telecom, satellite communications, aerospace, network optimization, operations research, or complex system modelling required; for Senior Engineer, 10+ years of relevant industry experience is required

- Strong knowledge of optimization algorithms, resource allocation, routing, scheduling, capacity planning, simulation, data analysis and performance modelling.

- Solid understanding of 5G NTN, MCC/SMO orchestration, RAN resources, beams/cells, feeder links, ISLs, gateways, satellite visibility constraints, QoS, slicing and traffic prioritization.

Essential experience

- Hands-on experience designing and validating optimization algorithms for radio, transport, gateway, feeder-link, ISL or multi-domain network resource allocation.

- Strong knowledge of classical and advanced optimization techniques, including graph algorithms, linear programming, mixed-integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics, metaheuristics and multi-objective optimization.

- Experience with traffic modelling, resource modelling, capacity planning, performance simulation, sensitivity analysis and scenario-based evaluation of algorithm behaviour.

- Ability to apply optimization methods to 5G-NTN orchestration problems, including beam/cell resource allocation, feeder-link sharing, ISL routing, gateway selection, congestion avoidance and service continuity.

- Experience translating system requirements, QoS objectives, slicing constraints, operational policies and SLA targets into mathematical models, optimization constraints and measurable algorithm KPIs.

- Highly desirable experience (several of the following):

- Experience with simulation and modelling tools such as Python, MATLAB, Julia, C++, network simulators, optimization libraries, graph libraries, data analysis frameworks or custom algorithm prototyping environments.

- Knowledge of 5G RAN and Core performance concepts, 3GPP NTN principles, O-RAN/SMO orchestration concepts, satellite payload constraints, feeder-link constraints, ISL routing and gateway resource management.

- Experience supporting trade-off studies, architecture decisions, technical evaluations, RFP/RFQ preparation, vendor challenge sessions and evidence-based comparison of algorithmic approaches.

- Experience with system engineering methods, requirement traceability, model validation, KPI definition, test scenario definition, integration planning and risk assessment for complex algorithms.

Proven work attitude:

Other key requirements / comments
