Engineer, RF/Performance RAN Simulation, IRIS2

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

PROGRAMME DESCRIPTION

IRIS² is the new European Union secure satellite communications constellation. This project is the European Union's answer to the pressing challenges of tomorrow to provide secure connectivity services and enhanced communication capacities to the EU and its Member States as well as to governmental users, private companies and European citizens while ensuring high-speed internet broadband to cope with connectivity dead zones.

SES – together with other consortium partners and core members – was selected by European Commission to build and to operate the IRIS² multi-orbit satellite constellation.

The IRIS² team enters the next project phase and there is a strong need for support for all the activities around service provisioning and products that the system can offer in the future.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The RF/Performance RAN Simulation Engineer is responsible for modelling, simulating, and assessing 5G RAN and RF performance for terrestrial and non-terrestrial network environments, with a strong focus on 5G-NTN, FR2 radio performance, beam hopping, coverage enhancement, SSB scheduling, and radio protocol call flow analysis. The role supports system design, performance trade-offs, test strategy, and technical inputs to RFP/RFQ activities.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Define and develop RAN/RF performance models and simulations for 5G and 5G-NTN systems, including coverage, capacity, link budget, throughput, latency, interference, mobility, and service availability aspects.

- Analyze 5G call flows and radio procedures impacting RAN performance, including synchronization, random access, RRC connection establishment, registration support, PDU session support, mobility, and beam management procedures.

- Model and evaluate FR2 RF performance, including propagation constraints, beamforming, antenna gain, EIRP, G/T, path loss, atmospheric losses, interference, Doppler, timing advance, and link adaptation behavior.

- Contribute to beam hopping and coverage enhancement studies for 5G-NTN, including beam planning assumptions, resource allocation constraints, dwell time, service continuity, and user experience impacts.

- Support technical studies, test principles, performance validation strategy, and RFP/RFQ preparation by translating simulation results into requirements, acceptance criteria, and supplier evaluation inputs

COMPETENCIES

- Ability to work with cross-discipline teams, including RAN experts, RF engineers, satellite engineers, software teams, IVV teams, procurement, and suppliers.

- Strong engineering discipline in documenting assumptions, models, simulation results, sensitivity analyses, open points, risks, and recommended design decisions.

- Communication skills, with the ability to explain complex RAN/RF performance and simulation outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical notes, simulation reports, RFP/RFQ inputs, and performance assessment documents.

- Commitment to deadlines and willingness to support demanding study, simulation, integration, and validation schedules.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Qualification Basis

- Master’s degree in engineering or science, preferably in Telecommunications, Radio Communications, RF Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related discipline.

- Experience in the telecom, satellite communications, or radio engineering industry required; for Senior Engineer, 7+ to 10+ years of relevant industry experience is preferred.

- Strong knowledge of 3GPP 5G RAN and 5G-NTN standards, including radio access procedures, physical layer assumptions, RRC behavior, SSB scheduling, MIB/SIB broadcast principles, and radio resource management concepts.

- Proven experience in RAN/RF performance modelling and simulation, using tools such as MATLAB, Python, link-level simulators, system-level simulators, radio planning tools, or equivalent engineering environments.

Essential experience

- Hands-on experience with RAN/RF performance modelling, including call flow impacts, radio resource allocation, coverage, capacity, throughput, latency, link budget, interference, and mobility performance analysis.

- Good understanding of 5G radio protocols and procedures impacting performance, including PHY/MAC interaction, RLC, PDCP, RRC, SSB scheduling, MIB/SIB broadcasting, random access, HARQ, link adaptation, and scheduling principles.

- Experience using MATLAB or equivalent tools to build simulations, run parameter studies, analyze results, generate plots, and support technical decision-making for RAN and RF design.

- Knowledge of 5G-NTN constraints and enhancements, including satellite delay, Doppler, feeder/user link characteristics, beam management, beam hopping, coverage enhancement, and service continuity challenges.

- Ability to define and apply testing and validation principles, including requirements traceability, simulation assumptions, test coverage, performance KPIs, acceptance thresholds, and comparison between simulation and lab or field results.

Highly desirable experience (several of the following):

- Experience with FR2 RF performance analysis, including mmWave propagation, beamforming, antenna patterns, blockage, atmospheric attenuation, high-gain antennas, and RF link budget trade-offs.

- Experience with beam hopping, dynamic coverage management, energy-saving techniques, or AI/ML-based optimization for 5G RAN or 5G-NTN systems.

- Experience with 3GPP-based performance studies, including interpretation of specifications, system assumptions, KPIs, simulation campaigns, and technical contributions to design or supplier discussions.

- Experience contributing to RFP and RFQ packages, including technical requirement definition, performance model assumptions, simulation evidence, acceptance KPIs, and evaluation of vendor responses.

The role covers end-to-end system architecture across RAN, Core, satellite payload, gateways, ISL/feeder links, orchestration, operations, and interfaces with SMO, SDN-C, GW Manager, S3C, and OSS/BSS. The engineer works closely with the IRIS2 MCC design teams and the SMO architecture team, with a particular focus on defining the MCC-SMO interfaces and ensuring that service and system requirements are correctly translated into MCC functional architecture.

General work requirements

- Translate service, mission, operational, and system requirements into MCC functional architecture, including planning, resource orchestration, contingency management, monitoring, and operational control functions.

- Define and structure MCC interfaces with SMO, SDN-C, GW Manager, S3C, OSS/BSS, and other ground or space segment functions, including interface scope, information flows, responsibility split, and ICD inputs.

- Challenge and support the IRIS2 MCC design teams on architecture assumptions, requirement completeness, functional decomposition, operational scenarios, contingency handling, and system-level trade-offs.

- Support the definition of MCC-SMO interfaces required by the SMO architecture team, including resource orchestration, RAN configuration intent, performance/availability feedback, fault coordination, and lifecycle management information flows.

- Contribute to RFP/RFQ preparation, technical requirement baselines, vendor technical evaluation, compliance analysis, and trade-off studies for MCC-related subsystems and interfaces.

Qualifications Background and Experience

Qualification Basis

- Master's degree in engineering or science, preferably in Telecommunications Engineering, Systems Engineering, Space Systems, or a related technical discipline.

- Experience in telecom, satellite communications, aerospace, defence, or complex system programmes required; for Senior Engineer, 10+ years of relevant industry experience is required.

- Strong end-to-end knowledge of 5G-NTN system architecture, covering RAN, Core Network, satellite payload, gateways, inter-satellite links, feeder links, orchestration, and operations.

- Solid knowledge of 3GPP NTN, O-RAN/SMO concepts, network management, transport routing, system engineering, interface definition, and ICD preparation.

Essential experience

- Hands-on experience translating service and system requirements into functional architectures, subsystem responsibilities, interface requirements, operational concepts, and verification inputs.

- Strong understanding of MCC functions such as mission and service planning, resource orchestration, contingency management, service continuity, network monitoring, and cross-domain coordination.

- Experience defining interfaces and ICDs between complex subsystems, including information models, operational flows, configuration data, monitoring data, fault/performance information, and control responsibilities.

- Good knowledge of 5G and 5G-NTN architecture, including RAN/Core interactions, SMO and O-RAN management concepts, transport routing, gateways, feeder links, ISL routing, and satellite payload constraints.

- Experience supporting RFP/RFQ activities, vendor technical evaluation, compliance matrices, gap analysis, clarification workshops, and technical trade-off studies.

- Highly desirable experience (several of the following):

- Experience working on MCC, NMS/OSS, SMO, SDN controller, gateway management, satellite control, or multi-domain orchestration systems.

- Knowledge of O-RAN SMO, Non-RT RIC concepts, O1/A1/O2 interfaces, and how SMO can interact with a higher-level MCC for NTN resource orchestration.

- Experience with network management concepts including FCAPS, configuration management, performance management, fault management, topology/resource inventory, and service assurance.

- Experience with system engineering methods, MBSE concepts, V-model development, requirement traceability, operational scenario analysis, and architecture review boards.

Proven work attitude:

Other key requirements / comments

- Management of technology development, work with cross discipline teams (MCC architects, SMO/RAN experts, core network experts, satellite payload engineers, gateway teams, operations, procurement, sales, business experts, etc.)

- Research and Development project management experience, including coordination of architecture reviews, requirement clarification workshops, vendor discussions, and technical decision records

- Communication skills, ability to explain complex MCC, SMO, 5G-NTN, satellite, and orchestration concepts to non-technical stakeholders

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear requirements, ICD inputs, RFP/RFQ technical sections, evaluation reports, and architecture notes

- Commitment to deadlines and willingness to meet tight development, procurement, architecture, and delivery schedules

- - The candidate must be eligible for a “SECRET” security clearance, in accordance with the national regulations as well as EU/ESA/NATO equivalents

- Willing to work 60% onsite from office

- Travel as required for project realization purposes

postings.description:
Senior Payload Engineer, Spacecraft Programmes

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

As Senior Payload Engineer, Space Programmes, you will be responsible for providing resident payload (repeater and antenna subsystems) engineering support to all phases of the satellite procurement programs which includes daily oversight of Design, Assembly, Integration, and Launch Campaign. You will be part of the SES Resident Field Office Team located at spacecraft manufacturer premises. You will support the Field Office in addressing product assurance and quality oversight of all aspects of the project. You will review and trend the test data for the payload equipment at unit and subsystems level tests and provide technical support to the Field Office Program Manager on investigations, resolutions and corrective actions.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULTS AREAS

- Ensure that the specification of each payload equipment unit is consistent with meeting the end-to-end system performance and functional requirements

- Ensure that all payload units, subsystem and system test procedures comply with the contractual requirements

- Participate in design, test readiness, material and failure review meetings at manufacturer sub- and prime- contractor facilities as needed

- Monitor flow of payload components through build, test and integration into next higher assembly.

- Critically examine the anomaly investigation results in root cause analysis and verify corrective actions are implemented

- Provide daily oversight of Design, Assembly, Integration, Test, and Launch phases

- Provide daily oversight of activities at Manufacturer and Subcontractor facilities as needed

- Ensure that the specification of each payload equipment unit meets the end-to-end system performance and functional requirements

- Perform in process inspections with manufacturers

- Perform the equipment and Spacecraft repeater and antenna test data review for compliance with contractual requirements

- Contribute digital payload expertise to innovation projects pursued by technology in interaction with the satellite manufacturer

- Contribute digital payload expertise to RFI/RFP discussions with the satellite manufacturer

- Support the SES Product Assurance Lead in MPCB, PCB, and RCB meetings, as well as in the review and approval of EEE parts, materials, mechanical parts, and processes

- Monitoring integration and test activities with quality assurance audits, mandatory and key inspection points, test witnessing and configuration inspections

- Critically examine the anomaly investigation results to root cause analysis and verify corrective actions are implemented

- Review design, manufacturing and test documentation

- Provide summary reports of issues and recommended actions

- Ensure that the program action items are adequately addressed and closed

- Provide 24/7 on call support during payload system testing

- Support Payload In Orbit Testing (PIOT) post launch activities

- Flexible to work across various projects as required

- Act as Payload expert for other people in SES Group and to satellite users pertaining to satellite performance. Support end-to-end design solutions. Requires a thorough understanding of end-to-end communications link budgets and infrastructure

- Develop training material and provide technical training to satellite engineering team

COMPETENCIES

- High level knowledge in satellite payload subsystems and ability to challenge industry expert in their field

- Self-Starter with a high level of personal accountability

- Prioritization

- Team Player

- Demonstrated influencing and negotiation skills

- A willingness to be self-critical, continuously improves skills, learn from mistakes, acts within her

- or his circle of competence and knows their boundaries

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Master’s degree or PhD in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering or related discipline

- 7+ years of applicable experience in Space Engineering

- Experience with payload mission specification and operations

- Experience with analogue and digital payload equipment

- Experience with repeater and/or antenna subsystems

- Experience with link budgets and repeater RF performance measurement

- Strong ability in persuasive and diplomatic communication to inspire collaboration and drive collective goal achievement

- Strong ability to work independently and with limited supervision in complex environments, including multi-stakeholder projects

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

- Willing to work at least 80% onsite from office

- Willingness to travel (supplier visits) - 30% domestic and international travel

postings.title: Senior Principal Media Architect
postings.description:
Senior Architect, Media Architecture 1

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Senior Principal Media Architect / Analyst is a senior technical contributor responsible for defining, maintaining, and evolving the technical architectures that support the organization’s media services and platforms. The role develops standardized, scalable, and supportable service designs that translate product and commercial requirements into implementation-ready technical solutions.

This position serves as a technical authority within the Media Architecture team and helps ensure that the organization’s media platforms continuously and reliably deliver the services sold to customers while realizing the adoption of reusable reference architectures, homogeneous design patterns, and engineering best practices that reduce unnecessary technical variation while accelerating the delivery of new services.

We are seeking a candidate to lead a team of technical professionals in identifying requirements, architectural gaps, implementation dependencies, and operational considerations early in the service-development lifecycle. This role will serve as a critical bridge between customer requirements, solution architecture, engineering execution, and operational readiness. The successful candidate will drive greater standardization, documentation quality, monitoring, supportability, and technical governance, contributing to improved service stability, reduced technical debt, fewer recurring architecture-related incidents, and a more scalable and repeatable approach to delivering media services across the organization.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Define, maintain, and evolve reusable reference architectures, standardized design patterns, and target-state architectures across the organization’s media platforms and services.

- Convert product capabilities, customer requirements, service definitions, and commercial commitments into scalable, supportable, and technically achievable architectures.

- Develop and govern high-level designs, logical signal flows, system boundaries, interfaces, dependencies, resiliency models, monitoring requirements, capacity considerations, and operational requirements.

- Provide architectural leadership for major transformation initiatives, assess emerging technologies, simplify and consolidate platforms, reduce technical debt, and incorporate lessons from deployments and operational incidents into future architecture standards and designs.

- Partner with Product, Commercial, Planning, and Engineering teams to ensure product roadmaps and proposed services remain aligned with current and planned platform capabilities.

- Coordinate requirements across Product, Planning, Network Engineering, Media Engineering, Execution, and Operations, resolving design conflicts and identifying dependencies, constraints, and risks early in the service lifecycle.

- Support Planning and Media Architects with solution shaping, technical feasibility assessments, architecture guardrails, and identification of operational or implementation constraints before commitments are finalized.

- Lead architecture reviews, govern compliance with approved standards, define required engineering deliverables, maintain architecture decision traceability, and provide technical approval for proposed media solutions.

- Provide implementation-ready architectural direction, define sequencing, migration and rollback considerations, establish acceptance criteria, support Engineering Design Readiness reviews, and confirm deployed solutions remain aligned with approved designs.

- Ensure new services include implementation traceability, service inventory, operational documentation, support procedures, recovery requirements, and formal handover criteria.

COMPETENCIES

- Represent the Media Engineering &Architecture team in technical working sessions and cross-functional project discussions as assigned.

- Ensure project execution follows defined engineering processes, meets operational requirements, and maintains high‑quality deliverables and documentation.

- Provide technical leadership and architecture governance with an end-to end system thinking for the early identification of technical gaps, operational risks, and implementation dependencies

- Introduce and enforce operational readiness to media implementation processes and foster cross-functional collaboration in complete and consistent architecture and as-build documentation

- Continuously support Product, Commercial, Planning, Engineering, Execution, and Operations in the reduction of design exceptions, unsupported implementations, and unnecessary technical variation.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, telecommunications, computer engineering, computer science, broadcast engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

- At least seven years of experience designing, integrating, implementing, or supporting complex media, broadcast, video, telecommunications, or content-distribution systems.

- Demonstrated experience developing end-to-end technical architectures involving multiple platforms, locations, interfaces, and engineering disciplines.

- Strong understanding of architecture principles, systems engineering, technical governance, and service lifecycle management.

- Experience creating high-level designs, reference architectures, system diagrams, signal flows, technical standards, and implementation requirements.

- Experience translating product, business, or customer requirements into technically realizable solutions.

- Strong understanding of service resilience, redundancy, monitoring, fault management, capacity planning, performance, and operational support requirements.

- Ability to evaluate complex technical information and communicate clear recommendations to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

- Strong written communication, technical documentation, facilitation, and presentation skills.

- Ability to perform physical support activities when required (e.g., cable handling, racking/stacking hardware).

- Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 20–25%.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

- Advanced degree in engineering, telecommunications, computer science, systems architecture, or a related discipline.

- Expert-level knowledge with large-scale media contribution, processing, transport, distribution, or playout environments.

- Expert-level knowledge with traditional broadcast, IP-based media, cloud, virtualized, and hybrid media architectures.

- Experience with media-service monitoring, service inventory, configuration management, CMDB integration, and operational-assurance platforms.

- Experience supporting major platform transformations, network migrations, technology-refresh programs, or service-modernization initiatives.

- Expert-level knowledge defining architecture exception processes, technical-debt remediation plans, or target-state roadmaps.

- Experience with formal systems-engineering, enterprise-architecture, or architecture-governance frameworks.

- Experience mentoring engineers or providing technical leadership across geographically distributed teams.

postings.title: Senior Product Program Specialist
postings.description:
Senior Product Program Specialist

About SES

At SES, we believe connectivity should empower people, communities, and businesses everywhere. As a global leader in satellite-enabled communications, we operate the world’s only multi‑orbit GEO and MEO constellation, delivering high‑performance connectivity and media services across aviation, maritime, government, enterprise, and mobility sectors.

Our culture is built on innovation, customer focus, technical excellence, and global collaboration. We solve complex challenges, develop cutting‑edge technologies, and deliver mission‑critical services with real‑world impact. If you’re driven by curiosity and passionate about shaping the future of connectivity, SES offers a place to build and grow your career.

Product Program Manager

Experience Level: 7–10 years

Location: Romania

Department: Product Portfolio and Program Management

About the Role

SES is seeking an experienced Product Program Manager to lead cross-functional, end-to-end product development programs across our diverse service portfolio. In this role, you will drive complex initiatives spanning engineering, product, network, operations, and vendor teams to ensure alignment, execution excellence, and delivery of high-impact products for SES’s global customers.

This position requires strategic thinking, the ability to dive into technical details, and the skills to build strong cross-functional relationships and lead through influence within a highly collaborative, international organization.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Execution

- Lead end-to-end, cross‑functional product development programs spanning engineering, product, operations, legal, procurement, and go‑to‑market teams.

- Build and maintain master schedules, manage critical paths, and drive alignment across teams.

- Oversee planning and iterative delivery using SAFe LPM and Agile frameworks.

- Track program health to ensure goals, scope, timelines, and deliverables stay on target.

Technical Program Management

- Partner with engineering and product teams, diving into technical workstreams to understand issues and connect cross-functional impacts.

- Facilitate technical discussions, resolve dependencies, and ensure solutions meet SES quality standards.

- Support Program Increment planning and guide Agile execution aligned with portfolio priorities.

Operational Excellence & Governance

- Develop and maintain key governance artifacts including RACIs, risk logs, mitigation plans, decision logs, and status reports.

- Identify and manage risks early, communicating clearly with stakeholders and leadership.

- Produce concise, executive-ready reporting on program status, risks, and financials.

Vendor & Contract Management

- Review, negotiate, and manage vendor SOWs.

- Track vendor milestones and deliverables, ensuring seamless integration with internal teams.

- Support milestone verification, acceptance criteria, and invoice approvals.

Financial & Budget Management

- Manage program budgets, forecasting, and cost tracking.

- Work with Finance on accruals, spend tracking, POs, and invoice processing.

- Ensure decisions align with financial targets and portfolio priorities.

Communication & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Build strong relationships across Engineering, Product, Finance, Operations, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to execute on program.

- Communicate goals, milestones, risks, and decisions clearly and consistently.

- Navigate a fast-paced, multicultural, distributed environment while managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor’s in engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related field.

- 7–10 years in Technical Program Management, Product Development or Product management.

- Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional, end-to-end programs in technical environments.

- Strong knowledge of SAFe LPM and Agile delivery frameworks.

- Demonstrated ability in building schedules, RACIs, risk management, and program dashboards.

- Experience managing budgets, accruals, financial reporting, and vendor invoices.

- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to connect cross-functional dependencies.

- Experienced in using project management tools such as Azure DevOps, PowerBI, JIRA, etc.

- Demonstrated ability to use AI in everyday project management activities.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

Preferred

- Experience in the satellite communications industry, including familiarity with satellite networks, service delivery platforms, ground systems, or network operations.

postings.title: Senior Specialist, Accounting Operations
postings.description:
Senior Accountant/ Senior Controller

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The incumbent is responsible for the completeness and accuracy of the general ledgers. This includes performance of financial analysis, application of IFRS and local regulations, and compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) regulations and with SES’s policies and procedures.

The incumbent has thorough understanding of Accounting Standards, has a good understanding of the processes feeding into the General Ledger accounting, and generally has at least five years’ experience in the role, or a directly similar role at another employer.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Completeness and documentation of financial records

- Ensure manual journal entries are properly recorded, with appropriate supporting documentation

- Reconcile balance sheet accounts ensuring high-accuracy financial reporting

- Identify, calculate, and record accrued expenses for services rendered but not yet invoiced

- As an entity controller, ensure accuracy of the general ledgers, including areas prepared by other departments (e.g. fixed assets transactions, revenue recognition, income taxes, etc.)

- Compliance of the financial records with SOX and SES policies and procedures

- Respect strict closing deadlines, to allow timely consolidation of SES’s results

- Ensure intercompany transactions are properly recorded and reconciled

- Maintain internal controls over financial reporting to meet SOX requirements

- Fulfilment of regulatory obligations associated with each entity

- Prepare annual statutory financial statements and any other tax filings or other reporting obligations

- Ensure compliance with applicable Accounting Standards and transfer pricing policies

- Financial analysis over Group results

- Prepare monthly review of companies’ results, including analysis of variances to prior and budget

- Oversight over external accounting service providers (if required)

- Review monthly reports from external providers, ensuring accuracy, including correct use of SES’s standard chart of accounts and cost centres

- Maintain reconciliation between IFRS consolidation ledger and local ledger (in SAP), as well as between local ledger (in SAP) and local ledger (in external provider’s system)

COMPETENCIES

- Excellent analytical skills and detail-focused

- Thorough understanding of Accounting Standards (IFRS)

- Continuous improvement mindset

- Ability to plan own time carefully and to prioritise with limited supervision

- Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in an international business environment

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or directly relevant professional qualification

- Advanced professional qualification (such as ACCA) preferred

- Proficiency in SAP

- Previous experience working in a SOX-compliant environment preferred

- More than five years operational experience in a similar role, preferably in a manufacturing company

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

- Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant foreign languages are an asset

The Senior Specialist, Payroll Americas & LATAM delivers payroll services for the Americas, covering the United States, Brazil, Mexico, Canada and Colombia. This role will support ongoing integration into S/4HANA, onboarding of new companies, audit compliance, and fixed asset reporting. The individual must have strong accounting acumen, a proactive compliance mindset, and a data-focused approach to ensure timely and accurate asset management across entities.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Maintain and manage the Fixed Asset Register, ensuring accurate recording of acquisitions, capitalizations, retirements, transfers, and adjustments.

- Execute monthly depreciation runs and ensure alignment with accounting standards and useful life policies.

- Perform fixed asset reconciliations (FA subledger vs GL), investigate variances, and drive timely resolution of discrepancies.

- Support fixed asset physical verification exercises and tagging in collaboration with business units.

- Ensure timely closure of Construction in Progress (CIP) and proper classification of assets as per capitalization policy.

- Review and validate asset additions against Capex approvals and ensure policy compliance before posting to the ledger.

- Maintain audit-ready documentation for all asset-related activities and support both internal and external audit requirements.

- Monitor and report on SOX and internal control compliance through dashboards, identifying risks and taking corrective actions.

- Support fixed asset process design and data migration during S/4HANA integrations and onboarding of new entities.

- Collaborate with the business, project teams, and accounting to ensure timely closure of open items and smooth period-end processing.

- Manage GR/IR clearing and reconciliations, ensuring timely follow-ups with relevant teams for resolution

- Manage end-to-end lease accounting activities in compliance with IFRS 16

- Leases including initial recognition, right-of-use (ROU), asset amortization, interests, lease liabilities, and modifications.

- Prepare monthly lease accounting entries, including depreciation of ROU assets and interest accretion on lease liabilities.

COMPETENCIES

- Detail Orientation & Accuracy: Maintains meticulous asset records and ensures high precision in all postings and reconciliations.

- Accounting & Compliance Focus: Strong grasp of fixed asset accounting principles, with an ability to enforce policies and controls.

- Time & Process Discipline: Delivers tasks under tight timelines, especially during month-end and year-end periods.

- Analytical & Reporting Abilities: Skilled in reviewing data, identifying gaps, and producing compliance or asset performance dashboards.

- Collaboration & Issue Resolution: Coordinates with stakeholders (e.g., project teams, controllers) to close exceptions proactively.

- ERP Knowledge: Experience in S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) module is essential.

- Accounting Standards: Familiarity with IFRS/GAAP for asset capitalization, impairment, depreciation, lease liability, ROU and interest.

- Technical Tools: Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with automation tools, scripts, or dashboarding is an added advantage.

- Work Experience: 8–10 years of relevant experience in Fixed Asset Accounting, preferably within a shared services or corporate environment with audit exposure.

postings.description:
Specialist, Talent Acquisition

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

At SES our ambition is to do the extraordinary in space in order to deliver amazing experiences everywhere on earth and we would not be able to do this if it wasn’t for the amazingly talented SESers! Part of the Talent Acquisition team, you will be at the heart of what it means to search, attract, identify, and hire incredibly talented individuals who make our ambition a reality!

As a Specialist, Talent Acquisition at SES you will have responsibility for Talent Acquisition activities in Europe and sometimes globally. You will be responsible for the successful management of end to end recruitment campaigns from cradle to grave. You will be identifying, selecting and hiring in competitive technical talent markets for SES. Your role will involve managing internal stakeholders (hiring managers, HC colleagues) as well as the candidates ensuring all have a great experience. Your work will directly impact the growth of the business and you will create and own talent sourcing strategies to support high growth areas to enable the business to scale at pace.You will be a brand ambassador for SES and work on specific events to attract talent.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- A strategic recruitment role using your wide international experience to design processes and talent strategies for key technical areas of the business

- Partnering with key business stakeholders to understand the future of their teams and building recruitment plans to support the growing areas

- Responsible for full cycle technical OR non-technical recruitment and end to end management of open requisitions, including line manger intake calls, creating and posting job ads, proactive and diverse candidate search, applicants screening and interviewing, job offers and contracts

- Actively build and maintain excellent relationships with candidates, colleagues and business leaders bringing real time data intelligence to your searches to help the business make informed data-led decisions on hiring

- Be the ambassador for the company brand and culture and you instinctively sell opportunities for candidates to join an employer of choice

- Be the trusted adviser, who partners with technical business functions to understand their current and longer-term strategic skill requirements, you will not be afraid to challenge the status quo and will create and own bespoke hiring strategies for complex hires

- Provide an amazing candidate experience as this is the most critical aspect of effective talent acquisition

- Be a trusted point of contact for other HC functions, providing information and guidance and suggestions regarding the markets you are working and improvements in processes you share

- Make recommendations and provide participation in various events, job fairs, engagement with universities, professional associations, etc

- Understand how a global company operates, as well as the local market dynamics and how the TA team contributes to its success and the achievement of strategic objectives

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Minimum 4 years of recruitment experience, ideally combining both technical and non-technical hiring in global environments.

- Demonstrated success recruiting for STEM/technology roles as well as corporate, commercial, and leadership positions, enabling support across a diverse range of business functions.

postings.description:
Team Leader, Accounts Payable

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The position is responsible for the day-to-day management of part of the group’s Accounts Payable (A/P) team. The role ensures the efficient and accurate processing and settlement of vendor invoices, in compliance with audit regulations and internal controls. This includes regular reconciliations, such as GR/IR (Goods Received/Invoice Received analysis) to maintain accurate financial records.

The incumbent is responsible for making sure that all A/P processes are thoroughly understood, properly trained, and effectively executed within the team, with work distribution optimized to handle the workload efficiently. Additionally, the role involves managing queries from internal and external business partners with prompt and accurate responses, while also ensuring that recurring internal audit controls are followed to uphold the integrity and transparency of financial transactions.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Ensure smooth and consistent running of the vendor processing and settlement operations for all in-scope entities.

- Train, motivate, and supervise the A/P staff to create a high-performance team.

- Ensure both internal and external supplier issues are promptly and appropriately addressed.

- Follow a set of operational metrics used in monitoring performance and internal and external benchmarks, and work to continually improve the process and usage of staff resources within an agreed quality and control framework.

- Work closely with the Accounts Payable Senior Manager in proactively addressing process concerns, ensuring that an appropriate level of focused resources is dedicated to this area.

- Coordinate, and execute as required, vendor settlements and tracking file execution on existing bank platforms.

- Perform Goods Received/Invoice Received reconciliations to maintain accurate financial records.

- Preparation and review of free-form payments (FFPs) upon request from SES business areas.

- Perform periodical Internal Controls reviews and ensure control findings and weaknesses are promptly addressed.

- Generate any requested A/P reporting.

COMPETENCIES

- Able to give instructions clearly and allocate work fairly amongst the team members.

- Capable of working autonomously under time constraints with limited supervision.

- Positive attitude, attention to detail, and ability to prioritise multiple tasks or projects.

- Responsive to internal and external business partners in addressing needs / queries.

- Written and oral fluency in English & Romanian.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Strong process knowledge coupled with a good understanding of relevant accounting concepts.

- Supervisory skills – effective communication and leadership of a multi-cultural team.

- Written and oral fluency in English & Romanian.

Technical Program Manager (Agile), meoSphere

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

PROGRAMME DESCRIPTION

meoSphere is SES’s next-generation Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) satellite constellation, designed to deliver secure connectivity services to government agencies, enterprises, and commercial customers. It will also provide high-speed broadband internet to eliminate global connectivity dead zones.

To accelerate development timelines, reduce costs, and ensure quality, SES is internalizing a critical segment of the satellite supply chain: the final integration of partner satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads, all within a cutting-edge manufacturing and test facility.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Agile Technical Program Manager (ATPM) is responsible for leading the execution, planning, integration, agile delivery and overall programmatic performance of a major team/segment as part of the greater meoSphere Integrated Product Team (IPT).

Reporting to the VP Programme Management and matrixed into the relevant segment team, the ATPM forms a delivery leadership partnership with the segment Technical Lead, combining technical understanding with agile execution, conventional program controls, cross-segment integration and IPT leadership to ensure successful delivery of program objectives.

The ATPM is a key driver of SES's transformation towards a highly agile, collaborative and integrated way of working, enabling rapid learning cycles, continuous integration and delivery across the meoSphere programme.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

Programme & Delivery Leadership

- Lead planning, execution, and delivery of the assigned segment/team.

- Partner with the Technical Lead to establish priorities, objectives, and delivery plans.

- Drive alignment between technical activities, programme objectives, and business priorities.

- Foster collaboration across segments and promote a One-Team culture across meoSphere and wider SES stakeholders.

Agile Execution

- Foster a culture of innovation, speed and accountability, leveraging iterative development, rapid prototyping and continuous learning.

- Support implementation of SAFe-inspired agile practices across the programme.

- Facilitate Program Increment (PI) planning, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives for the assigned segment/team.

- Drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement through agile delivery practices.

- Monitor delivery performance against PI objectives, identify blockers, and drive resolution to maintain delivery commitments.

Programme Management

- Manage scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, and change activities for the assigned segment.

- Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestone schedules and forecasts, ensuring early identification of delivery risks.

- Coordinate dependencies across programme segments and external partners, driving timely resolution of integration and delivery risks.

- Support programme reporting, forecasting and governance activities, providing clear visibility of delivery health and progress.

Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary programme interface for the assigned segment.

- Engage with engineering, operations, procurement, finance, suppliers and leadership stakeholders.

- Provide timely and accurate status, risk, dependency, and decision information to support effective programme execution.

KEY COMPETENCIES

- Programme & Delivery Leadership. Drives execution, delivery outcomes and team accountability in a complex Agile environment.

- Agile Delivery. Applies Agile practices to plan, prioritize and deliver work iteratively while adapting to changing programme needs.

- Stakeholder Management & Influence. Builds alignment across technical and business stakeholders, communicating effectively and influencing without direct authority.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partners effectively across teams, functions and external partners to achieve shared programme objectives.

- Systems Thinking. Understands interdependencies, integration points and programme-level impacts of decisions and trade-offs.

- Risk & Issue Management. Proactively identifoes, manages and resolves risks, issues and delivery dependencies.

Qualifications Background and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or another relevant technical discipline.

- Typically 8+ years of relevant experience leading complex technical programmes, projects or engineering developments.

- Experience delivering major subsystems, workstreams or integrated teams within a complex technical environment.

- Strong programme and project management experience covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, resource and change management.

- Strong understanding of systems engineering, integration and verification activities.

- Practical experience working in Agile environments and applying Agile delivery practices.

- Experience within the satellite, space, aerospace, telecommunications or similarly complex systems industries.

Preferred Experience & Qualifications

- Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains or other large-scale Agile delivery frameworks.

- Understanding of LEO, MEO and GEO satellite systems, ground infrastructure and network integration.

- Experience using enterprise programme and project management tools to support planning, reporting and governance.

- Professional certification in programme/project management, Agile delivery or systems engineering (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PMI-ACP, Scrum, INCOSE).

- Experience working within highly regulated, safety-critical or mission-critical engineering environments.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS

- The candidate must be eligible for a “SECRET” security clearance, in accordance with the national regulations as well as EU/ESA/NATO equivalents

- Willing to work 60% onsite from office

- Travel as required for project realization purposes

Technician, Teleport Operations

- You will perform routine on-site installation, preventative maintenance, routine repair of electronic and electromechanical equipment and products. You will ensure system performance of communications equipment delivers the highest standard of service to our customers and perform level 1 maintenance restoral actions and well as provide technical support at an intermediate level in 24x7 shift.

You investigate and report any equipment deficiencies related to reliability, or efficiency for service operations. You escalate open issues to senior technician or more senior operations staff. - 1 to 3 years of relevant experience.

- Must be able to work in a 24x7 shift environment (days/nights) and be available for on-call/call-in responsibilities.

- Basic working knowledge of Satellite Earth Station technologies relating to Teleport Operations.

- Good organizational, multi-tasking and team player skills.

- Fluency in English.

- Good customer service skills.

- General PC skills and proficiency in use of “Office Suite” software.

- General working knowledge of standard test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, frequency counters, power meters, synthesized generators, oscilloscopes, multimeters, bit error rate test sets.

postings.title: Telecom OSS Orchestration & Inventory Engineer
postings.description:
Telecom OSS Orchestration & Inventory Engineer

Role description summary

We are seeking a specialist in service orchestration, service modeling, and resource/service inventory for telecom and satcom services.

The role involves analyzing product and network requirements, defining service models (CFS/RFS/Resource), maintaining catalog and inventory representations, and configuring these models in orchestration or catalog platforms.

The successful candidate will work closely with product, engineering, fulfillment, and orchestration teams to ensure accurate service representation aligned with MEF, TMF, and industry-standard fulfillment processes.

The candidate should have experience with any industry orchestration, catalog, or inventory system and a solid understanding of network concepts across IP, transport, RF, and satellite systems. Familiarity with TMF Open APIs, TMF SID, MEF service frameworks, and fulfillment lifecycles is strongly preferred.

A strong plus is hands-on experience implementing or supporting ServiceNow OMT including product catalog, service specifications, order flows, and orchestration logic.

Based in the Chennai facilities, you will be part of a dynamic global operations and orchestration team enabling data-driven service delivery and supporting SES’s digital transformation journey.

Primary responsibilities / Key result areas

- Analyze telco/satcom services, network configurations, and product definitions to design accurate CFS, RFS, and Resource models.

- Produce and maintain service specifications, technical attributes, service parameters, and mapping rules for ServiceNow OMT.

- Configure ServiceNow OMT product and service catalogs, including catalog items, service specs, product models, templates, and decomposition rules.

- Collaborate with engineering and provisioning teams to align service models with real network topology and provisioning flows.

- Define order workflows, fulfillment logic, task sequences, dependencies, and orchestration rules.

- Ensure data consistency and governance across service models, resources, catalogs, and fulfillment components using TMF and MEF standards.

- Support TMF-aligned fulfillment processes, contributing to end‑to‑end service lifecycle automation.

- Document service models, service hierarchies, attribute specifications, dependencies, and configuration details.

- Identify and implement improvements in service modeling, catalog integrity, and fulfillment design.

- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to validate requirements and ensure alignment with target service architecture.

- Contribute to transformation projects ensuring catalog configurations, models, and workflows comply with TMF/MEF and internal standards.

- Support audits, compliance reviews, and continuous governance of service catalogs and specifications.

COMPETENCIES

- Strong understanding of service orchestration, service modelling, and fulfilment processes.

- Experience with service catalog, inventory, or orchestration platforms.

- Strong expertise in telecom/satcom service modeling, including CFS, RFS, Resource models.

- Proficient with TM Forum frameworks: SID, Open APIs, ESP, and fulfillment process models.

- Knowledge of MEF service frameworks, especially MEF LSO and service specification guidelines.

- Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow OMT, including product catalog, service specification, and order flow configuration (strong advantage).

- Understanding of telecom network technologies: IP, transport, RF, fiber, GEO/MEO/LEO architectures.

- Experience designing fulfillment workflows and service decomposition logic.

- Strong business analysis and requirement-gathering skills related to service portfolios.

- Knowledge of data modeling, service governance, and catalog lifecycle management.

- Ability to communicate service models and architecture to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

- Analytical, detail‑oriented, with strong problem‑solving capabilities.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.

Qualifications & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Telecommunications, Business Engineering, or a related field.

- Minimum of 8 years of experience

- Deep telecom/satcom domain expertise preferred.

- Extensive experience in service modeling and fulfillment.

- 1+ years working with ServiceNow (OMT preferred).

- ServiceNow OMT certification is highly desirable.

- Experience working with TMF SID, TMF ESP, and MEF LSO standards is highly desirable.

- Experience preparing documentation for catalogs, models, workflows, and architecture.

- Familiarity with DevOps tools and agile processes is a plus.

Other key requirements / comments

- Flexibility to adapt to changing business needs and evolving technological landscapes

- Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment and manage multiple priorities effectively

- Commitment to deadlines and willingness to meet tight schedules

- Fluent in English

- Working hours will be aligned with CET time zone

postings.title: Test Engineer, Satellite Manufacturing
postings.description:
Test Engineer, Satellite Manufacturing

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

We are seeking a hands-on and motivated Test Engineer to support the Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) of satellite electronic systems, with a strong focus on building and scaling production capabilities.

This role will play a key part in transitioning from early production builds to serial manufacturing. You will be responsible not only for testing and validation of flight hardware, but also for developing robust, scalable test systems and processes to support increasing production volumes.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

Test Development & Execution

- Develop, maintain, and execute test procedures for:

- Electronic assemblies (PCBAs, harnesses)

- Subsystems (avionics, power, RF)

- Fully integrated satellite systems

- Define test criteria and pass/fail requirements

- Perform functional and system-level testing using lab equipment

Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT)

- Support satellite integration and system validation activities

- Perform end-to-end testing of spacecraft prior to qualification and launch readiness

- Verify electrical interfaces, system performance, and operational functionality

Environmental & Qualification Testing

- Support and execute environmental test campaigns, including:

- Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing

- Vibration and shock (shaker) testing

postings.title: Video Distribution Architect
postings.description:
Senior Architect, Video Distribution

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Video Distribution Architect sits within C-Band Ground Implementation team and is responsible for the end-to-end strategy, architecture, design, deployment, and lifecycle management of the company's terrestrial packet recovery network based on the Video Services Forum specifications governing hybrid satellite-terrestrial delivery with selective programming (VSF TR-06-4 Parts 6 & 7).

This role serves as the technical authority for terrestrial IP, Recovery Network Architecture, packet recovery, and next-generation video transport technologies acting as the survivable backup and recovery path supplementing SES’s primary Ku-band video distribution across CONUS to deliver a highly resilient hybrid distribution platform. The role is responsible for ensuring carrier-grade reliability, packet integrity, low latency, and operational resilience across all video distribution workflows.

The individual will work closely with Media Engineering, Network Engineering, Customer Operations, Cybersecurity, and external technology partners to ensure scalable, standards-based video delivery architectures capable of supporting both current and future business requirements.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

- Architect a terrestrial packet recovery network that complements and protects the primary GEO (Ku-band) satellite distribution infrastructure

- Lead the design and implementation of a VSF TR-06-4 compliant packet recovery architecture, specifically supporting:

- Part 6 – Transport Stream Program Selection

- Part 7 – Packet and Full‑Stream Recovery

- Establish recovery mechanisms capable of:

- Detecting packet loss across the satellite distribution environment.

- Delivering missing packets through a geographically diverse terrestrial IP network.

- Reconstructing video streams in real time at affiliate and distribution endpoints.

- Supporting seamless recovery without viewer impact.

- Define architecture standards for:

- Packet loss detection

- Recovery orchestration

- Recovery data transport

- Timing synchronization

- Network monitoring

- Operational reporting

- Develop packet recovery performance objectives including:

- Recovery rate targets

- Latency budgets

- Recovery network availability

- Recovery event reporting

- Ensure the recovery platform can scale to support the video services necessary to mitigate significant weather-related outages and impacts

- Design and optimize the Terrestrial Recovery Network Architecture supporting live and linear video delivery while minimizing latency and satisfying peak demand

- Define the Concept of Operations (CONOPS) for the packet recovery network that minimizes SES’s role coming between our customers and their affiliates yet ensures sufficient command and control of the network to optimize performance

- Evaluate commercial technology partners and their solution offerings to deliver a best of breed solution and ensure interoperability with customers’ preferred TAP and receiver vendors

- Manage vendor relationships and partnerships essential for the design and implementation of the packet recovery network, clearly conveying the vision & requirements and providing day to day direction as necessary

- Define end-to-end testing strategy and manage scope and capabilities of required lab environment(s)

- Act as subject matter expert on behalf of project for internal and external stakeholders

COMPETENCIES

- Demonstrated systems thinking, viewing hybrid video distribution as an end-to-end ecosystem rather than a collection of individual technologies

- Proven ability to understand the “big picture” and connect architecture to strategic outcomes, balancing performance, resiliency, scalability, supportability and cost

- Strong decision making, evaluating competing technical approaches and making timely, data-driven decisions

- Advanced communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex technical topics and influence stakeholders

- High emotional intelligence; able to navigate challenging situations and maintain credibility

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Broadcast Engineering, or related discipline

- 10+ years of experience designing large-scale video distribution and IP-based media transport networks

- Experience designing carrier-grade video delivery architectures

- Hands-on experience with packet recovery networks (ARQ), RIST-based transport, or media edge distribution architectures preferred

- Expertise with hybrid video delivery leveraging satellite distribution systems preferred

The salary range for this full-time position is $134,900 - $208,500 .

Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and geographic location. Individual compensation within the range is determined based on work location and a variety of factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and relevant education or training.
